items.how: Signed independence declaration from partner and team; s.141 eligibility checklist on file.
items.ref: Code of Ethics; s.141 Companies Act 2013
steps: Obtain signed independence declarations from the engagement partner and every team member
Check s.141 disqualifications: relatives' holdings, loans or guarantees, business relationships, other audit limits
Record conclusion on eligibility and file the declarations
items.text: Confirm independence and eligibility: no disqualification through relatives, indebtedness, guarantees or business relationships.

items.how: Copy of letter with proof of delivery (RPAD / email acknowledgement).
items.ref: Clause (8), Part I, First Schedule, CA Act 1949
steps: Send the written communication to the previous auditor by RPAD or email
Obtain proof of delivery / acknowledgement
Note any professional reasons raised by the previous auditor and how they were addressed
items.text: Written communication sent to the previous auditor before accepting the appointment.

items.ref: s.139 Companies Act; partners' / trustees' resolution
steps: Obtain the appointment letter and the board / members' / partners' resolution
For companies, verify ADT-1 SRN and filing date on the MCA portal
Confirm the term of appointment covers this year
items.text: Appointment is valid and properly authorised; for companies, ADT-1 filed within 15 days of the AGM.

items.how: Signed engagement letter for the year.
steps: Draft the engagement letter covering scope, framework, management responsibilities and fees
Obtain the client's signed acceptance
File the signed copy
items.text: Terms of engagement agreed in writing: scope, reporting framework, management responsibilities, fees.

items.how: Engagement planning memo; EQCR assignment note.
steps: Assign engagement partner, team and quality reviewer (where required)
Record competence and independence of each member
Document the assignment in the planning memo
items.text: Engagement team, engagement partner and quality reviewer (where required) assigned; team competence considered.

items.how: Copy of peer review certificate and validity date.
steps: Check whether the engagement requires a peer-reviewed auditor
Verify the firm's peer review certificate and validity date
File a copy
items.text: Firm holds a valid peer review certificate where the engagement requires one.

items.how: List of other services billed to the client in the year.
items.ref: Code of Ethics; s.144 Companies Act
steps: List all other services billed to the client this year
Check none is prohibited under s.144 / Code of Ethics
Compute fee dependence and record the conclusion
items.text: No prohibited non-audit services provided; fee dependence on the client reviewed.

items.how: Client profile note; walk-through of key processes.
steps: Hold a discussion with management on business, products, IT systems and changes this year
Walk through key processes (sales, purchase, payroll, treasury)
Prepare the client profile note
items.text: Understanding of the entity, its business, IT systems and applicable financial reporting framework documented.

items.how: UDIN list matched to signed reports.
steps: List every report and certificate signed for this client
Generate UDIN for each within the permitted time
Match UDINs to the signed reports
items.text: UDIN generated for every report and certificate issued for this client.

steps: Assemble the working papers after signing the report
Record the assembly date (within 60 days of the report)
Confirm the retention period and storage location
items.text: Working papers assembled within 60 days of the report date and retained for at least 7 years.
